jobs.title: VP, Operations and Services
jobs.description_text: Role Summary The VP, Operations & Services is a newly created leadership role responsible for bringing together the teams that support our commercial organization and customers across Ad Operations, Traffic Management, Account Management, and Demand Optimization. This leader will be responsible for creating greater consistency across these teams and how they work together, how they partner with Sales, and how we support our clients from the point a deal is signed through delivery and ongoing account management. We're looking for someone who has led operations and client service teams within ad tech or digital media and understands both programmatic and direct advertising. jobs.description_text: 클로버추얼패션 (CLO Virtual Fashion)은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘을 기반으로, 컨셉부터 디자인, 제조, 마케팅, 피팅, 스타일링까지 의상과 관련된 모든 서비스를 제공합니다. 2009년 설립된 클로버추얼패션은 3D 의상 시뮬레이션 알고리즘에 대한 독보적인 기술력을 바탕으로, 디지털 패션의 새로운 생태계를 만들어 가고 있습니다. 의상 디자인 소프트웨어 CLO, Marvelous Designer, Jinny와 함께, CLO-SET, CONNECT와 같은 의상 콘텐츠에 특화된 플랫폼으로 의상의 모든 여정에 관여하여 효율적이고 지속가능한 워크플로우를 구축하고 있습니다. 뿐만 아니라, 당사 솔루션을 통해 실제 의상과 디지털 의상이 서로 태그되어 CLO 시스템 내에서 기능할 수 있게끔 합니다. 글로벌 디지털 패션 시장을 주도하고 있는 클로버추얼패션은 현재 아시아, 북미, 유럽, 남미 등 전 세계 12개국에 총 16개의 오피스를 두고 있으며, 세계 각국의 수많은 고객사를 바탕으로 점점 확장해나가고 있습니다. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. This position is based in Washington, DC.
